name: Curious Poses

pitch_detail.notes: 5.8 start to first finger lock, then left-side crack on the fin above (thin tips crux, small nuts/cams).
Chimney above the big ledge to flaring hands; SS rap-ring anchor.

Gear for the flaring hands above the pitch 2 chimney
